description: 2 tactical challenges for Black in the Lasker Trap. Play 7...Bxf3! and punish both recaptures.

drills.briefExplanation: 7...Bxf3! 8.gxf3?? Nxe5! 9.f4 Ng6! — shatter the kingside, occupy e5, retreat with tempo.
drills.description: Black to play. White kicked the bishop with 7.h3?? — take it and spring the Lasker Trap.
drills.explanation: The Lasker Trap: 7...Bxf3! eliminates the knight defending e5. After the greedy 8.gxf3?? Black plays 8...Nxe5!, planting the knight on the dream outpost — it can't be touched, and White's kingside pawn structure is in ruins. After 9.f4 Ng6! the knight retreats with tempo, Black's pieces swarm, and White's extra pawn (e5) is gone with interest. Never kick a pinning bishop you can't recapture against.
drills.name: The Bxf3 Destruction

drills.briefExplanation: 8...Nxe5! 9.e3 dxe3 — win the e-pawn, then blast open the center.
drills.description: Black to play. White recaptured 8.Nxf3 — take the e5 pawn and open the position.
drills.explanation: The other recapture fails too: after 8.Nxf3 Black plays 8...Nxe5!, simply winning the e5 pawn — White can't take back (9.Nxe5?? Qxe5+ wins on the spot). After 9.e3 dxe3 Black has won two pawns (e5 and e3) with a crushing central position. Both of White's 8th-move options lose; the trap is airtight once 7.h3?? is played.
drills.name: The e5 Outpost

name: Lasker Trap — Black Tactics
